rules.audio_scope: Only audio files inside audio/ are used by default.
rules.video_scope: Only video_frames/ and explicitly declared module folders are scanned for video generation.
rules.reference_scope: reference_images/, character_refs/, environment_refs/, and whitebox_renders/ are reference-only unless promoted in a manifest.
rules.story_frames: Numbered frame_### assets are narrative timeline assets.
rules.whitebox_scope: Blender whitebox renders are spatial references only. They may lock composition and camera IDs, but they must not be final story frames.
rules.final_art_gate: A completed story frame must be generated for its story beat, pass hash QA, cite approved anchors, and not match any reference or whitebox render hash.
rules.contact_sheet_layers: Keep separate contact sheets for whitebox cameras, visual anchors, final story frames, and placeholder/rejected assets.
rules.asset_integrity: Numbered story files must pass hash QA before they count as completed frames. Reference/fallback copies are placeholder_from_reference. Whitebox/proxy outputs are whitebox_proxy_only.
rules.modules: module_NAME_### assets play in order within the module.
rules.aesthetic_pool: Unnumbered images may be selected by color, content, composition, and section intent.
